dedupe_keys.name: nuscenes and nuimages autonomous driving sensor datasets with maps of boston and singapore motional

description: nuScenes is a large public autonomous driving dataset with a full sensor suite, 3D annotations and semantic maps, and nuImages is its companion image dataset. Both are produced by Motional, formerly nuTonomy. Coverage: urban driving in Boston (Seaport) and Singapore (One North, Queenstown and Holland Village). The dataset provides scenes recorded with lidar, radar and cameras, 3D bounding box annotations with tracking, and expansions for lidar semantic segmentation (nuScenes-lidarseg), panoptic segmentation and tracking (Panoptic nuScenes), vehicle CAN bus data, and a map expansion with vector layers of lanes, crossings, traffic lights and a lidar basemap; challenges cover detection, tracking, prediction and segmentation. Format and access: downloads from nuscenes.org after sign-up, with the Python nuscenes-devkit (Apache 2.0, version 1.2.0 of August 2025) for loading, rendering and evaluation. Licence: nuScenes terms of use for the data, which restrict use to non-commercial research (the terms page could not be read here); devkit Apache 2.0. Caveats: the known issues list notes incorrect ego poses for a few scenes and zeroed traffic light poses in two Singapore areas; data were recorded around 2018 and cover small districts. Simulation uses: road user trajectories and lane-level maps for agent-based traffic behaviour models and road digital twins. Related records: Argoverse (data-argoverse-autonomous-driving-hd-maps) and the Waymo Open Dataset (data-waymo-open-dataset) are comparable driving datasets.
